statements.t: BTCS plans to continue expanding asset deployments into DeFi protocols and pursue additional integrations to broaden its on-chain activities, subject to market conditions, available capital, regulatory developments, and risk management considerations.

This approach allows the Company to actively manage its capital structure and allocate resources across its operating activities based on market conditions, expected returns, and liquidity requirements.

Management expects continued expansion of Imperium to drive scalable revenue generation and gross profit growth, while ongoing development of blockchain infrastructure operations around Builder+ is expected to support the Company’s broader strategy.

Management evaluates how digital assets are deployed among these activities based on expected revenue, profit margin, growth prospects, liquidity requirements, risk considerations, and prevailing market conditions.

Management believes that the active deployment of digital assets across DeFi and blockchain infrastructure activities is a core differentiator of the Company’s operating model and expects digital assets to remain central to the Company’s treasury strategy and overall business performance.
The Company will continue to evaluate these assets for impairment in future periods.
As there are no remaining warrant liabilities, the Company does not expect to recognize further gains or losses related to this item in future periods.

Because no shares were repurchased during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, no repurchase-related financing cash outflows are reflected in our condensed consolidated statement of cash flows for the period; repurchases made after September 30, 2026 will be presented as financing cash outflows in the period in which they occurred.

The Company expects that any future repurchases will be subject to our liquidity position, prevailing market conditions, and other capital allocation priorities, including funding of operations and strategic initiatives.
Management actively monitors collateralization ratios and protocol conditions and may reduce or repay borrowings in response to market movements or changes in risk tolerance.

The Company does not currently anticipate declaring regular cash or digital asset dividends, and the declaration of future dividends or other capital distributions, if any, will depend on the Company’s financial condition, results of operations, liquidity position, capital requirements, and other factors considered by the Board.

The Company’s financial statements have been prepared assuming that it will continue as a going concern, which contemplates continuity of operations, realization of assets, and settlement of liabilities in the normal course of business.

The Company believes that its existing cash and digital assets, together with the proceeds from recent convertible note financings and access to capital through its ATM Agreement, as well as its ability to manage liquidity through DeFi borrowing arrangements, provide sufficient liquidity to meet working capital requirements, anticipated capital expenditures, strategic initiatives, and contractual obligations for…

We anticipate future financing activity may include additional DeFi borrowings and capital raised through the ATM program or through other financing instruments, as we continue to scale blockchain infrastructure and DeFi operations, enhance liquidity, and support ongoing capital deployment.

estimates.t: The preparation of the Company’s financial statements in conformity with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”) requires management to make estimates, judgments, and assumptions that affect the reported amounts and disclosures.

statements.t: “ BTCS delivered a record $3.5 million in gross profit at an 86% gross margin, surpassing our full-year gross profit target of $6 million with a full quarter remaining in 2026.
Looking to the fourth quarter, we intend to keep scaling Imperium, and we expect it to remain the leading driver of our business.”
Reaching our $6 million gross profit target in nine months is a meaningful milestone, and we remain focused on scaling revenue and gross profit while managing our balance sheet with discipline. ”

Having surpassed its full-year gross profit target of $6 million through the first nine months of 2026, the Company expects Imperium to remain the primary driver of revenue and gross profit through the remainder of the year.
